dialogue.origin: 今日はよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming today. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.origin: はい。どちらの役ですか？
dialogue.content: Yes. Which role will you be taking?

dialogue.origin: 心理カウンセラー役→いじめ相談です
dialogue.content: I'll be in the role of a psychological counselor—this will be a consultation about bullying.

dialogue.origin: 了解しました
dialogue.content: Understood.

dialogue.origin: 確認して頂き、ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you for confirming.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは相談員です今日のご相談はどのようなご相談でしょうか
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 親のいじめにあっています
dialogue.content: I’m being bullied by parents.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね今はどこから相談してもらってますか？
dialogue.content: I see. Where are you reaching out from right now?

dialogue.origin: 近くに親御さんとかいますでしょうか
dialogue.content: Are your parents nearby?

dialogue.origin: 自分の部屋です
dialogue.content: I'm in my room.

dialogue.origin: 鍵とかはかかりますか
dialogue.content: Can you lock the door?

dialogue.origin: あ、違います。すみません。親同士のいじめです
dialogue.content: Oh, that's not it. I'm sorry. It's bullying among parents.

dialogue.origin: ごめんなさいね虐待のケースとかもあるので・・心配になってしまいました
dialogue.content: I apologize. There are cases of child abuse as well, so I became concerned.

dialogue.origin: すみません
dialogue.content: I'm sorry.

dialogue.origin: 具体的にどのようなことか教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me specifically what has been happening?

dialogue.origin: はい。娘の行ってる学校で、集団で無視されたり、いわれない悪口流されたりしてます
dialogue.content: Yes. At my daughter's school, I'm being ignored by a group of parents, and they're spreading baseless rumors about me.

dialogue.origin: そうでったんですねそれはお辛くなってしまいますね
dialogue.content: I see. That must be very painful for you.

dialogue.origin: 本当に酷くて寝込んでます
dialogue.content: It's really awful, and I've been bedridden.

dialogue.origin: え・・寝込んでしまわれるほど悩んでいらっしゃるんですねちなみに娘さんの年齢を教えてもらえすか
dialogue.content: Oh... so you're distressed to the point of being bedridden. By the way, could you tell me your daughter's age?

dialogue.origin: 中2です
dialogue.content: She's in her second year of junior high school.

dialogue.origin: 教えて頂きありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you for letting me know.

dialogue.origin: なにかきっかけとかは思いつきますでしょうか
dialogue.content: Can you think of anything that might have triggered this?

dialogue.origin: はい。私が保護者会の会長になったのがきっかけでした
dialogue.content: Yes. It started when I became the president of the parents' association.

dialogue.origin: そうでったんですね集団でとはクラスのママ友からと受け取っていいのでしょうか
dialogue.content: I see. When you say 'a group,' should I understand that to mean the mothers from your child's class?

dialogue.origin: いえ、上級生、同級生、下級生、運動部の保護者中心に中高一貫なので、高校までです
dialogue.content: No, it's mainly the parents from the sports clubs—of upperclassmen, classmates, and underclassmen. Since it's a combined junior and senior high school, it extends all the way up to high school.

dialogue.origin: 高校まで・・と思うと・・お辛い気持ちが伝わってきます無視するなんて許されないことですよねほんとうに毎日が気がめいってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: All the way through high school... Just thinking about it, I can feel how painful that must be. Being ignored like that is unforgivable. It must make every day so depressing.

dialogue.origin: きっかけとなるような出来事ってありましたか？
dialogue.content: Was there any specific incident that triggered this?

dialogue.origin: 会長さんをしている時に
dialogue.content: While you were serving as president?

dialogue.origin: 私が保護者会会長になったのが気に入らないって事でしょうね
dialogue.content: I suppose they just don't like that I became the parents' association president.

dialogue.origin: そうでったんですねそれはひどいですね・・
dialogue.content: I see. That's really awful...

dialogue.origin: 気にいらないって思うのはどういうところで、そう思われたんでしようか
dialogue.content: What do you think it is that makes them dislike it?

dialogue.origin: 今日のご相談は、これといってはっきりした心当たりがないのに、いじめらているのは理不尽でどうしたらいいか困ってらっしゃるってことなんでしょうか
dialogue.content: So, for today's consultation, is it that you're being bullied without any clear reason that you can think of, you feel it's unfair, and you're at a loss for what to do?

dialogue.origin: 学校の先生が言われていたんですが、何もかも手に入れてるみたいで気に入らないんじゃ無いかといわれてもう、愕然でした
dialogue.content: A teacher at the school said they might dislike me because it looks like I have everything, and I was just stunned to hear that.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですねあなたのことをひがんでいて・・という感じなんですね
dialogue.content: I see. So it sounds like they are jealous of you.

dialogue.origin: 本当に理不尽で納得がいかないですよね
dialogue.content: That's truly unfair and hard to accept, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: 自分の怒りが表現出来なくて苦しいです
dialogue.content: It's painful because I can't express my anger.

dialogue.origin: あなたが悪いわけではないのに・・
dialogue.content: Even though it's not your fault at all...

dialogue.origin: 腹立たしく思われるのは当然だと思います
dialogue.content: I think it's perfectly natural for you to feel angry.

dialogue.origin: どこに怒りをぶつけていいか・・ほんとうに悩んでしまいますよね
dialogue.content: You must be really struggling with where to direct that anger.

dialogue.origin: 私が寝込むと喜んでいるのは分かっているんですが、自分が弱くて負けて寝込んでます
dialogue.content: I know they're happy that I'm bedridden, but I feel weak and defeated for being this way.

dialogue.origin: このことを親しくしているママ友とかに相談はされｔますか
dialogue.content: Have you talked about this with any of your close mom friends?

dialogue.origin: はい。1人だけ味方がいます
dialogue.content: Yes. I have one person on my side.

dialogue.origin: 味方の方がいて安心しました
dialogue.content: I'm relieved to hear you have someone on your side.

dialogue.origin: その方には相談されてますか
dialogue.content: Have you talked to that person about it?

dialogue.origin: はい。ありがたい事に、私の事を良く分かってくれています
dialogue.content: Yes. Thankfully, she understands me very well.

dialogue.origin: それは良かったですここまでのお話をいったんまとめさせていただいてもよろしいでしょうか
dialogue.content: That's good to hear. Would it be all right if I summarize what we've talked about so far?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あなたが中学の運動部の会長になったことをきっかけで悪口や無視されて、寝込んでしまうほど精神的にまいっています
dialogue.content: Starting from when you became president of the parents' association for the sports club, you've been subjected to malicious rumors and ignored, and you've become so mentally exhausted that you're now bedridden.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 先生かたあなたが全部手に入れてたぶん羨ましくてひがんでいるのでは？と思われるのですね
dialogue.content: And a teacher suggested that it's probably because they are jealous and envious of you, as it seems you have everything.

dialogue.origin: ここまでのお話を伺って感じたことをお伝えしてもよろしいでしょうか
dialogue.content: May I share what I’m sensing from what you’ve told me so far?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 悪口を言ったり無視するようないじめをする方は一般的に劣等感があったり、自己顕示欲が強い方が多い傾向にあります
dialogue.content: Generally, people who bully by spreading rumors or ignoring others tend to have an inferiority complex or a strong desire for self-assertion.

dialogue.origin: あなたは全く悪くはありません
dialogue.content: You are not at fault at all.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: あなたのことがとてもうらやましくて蹴落とそうとしているだけだと思います
dialogue.content: I think they’re simply very envious of you and are trying to drag you down.

dialogue.origin: あなたは中学の会長さんをすすんでされるほどに責任感もありボランティア精神にあふれている方だと思います
dialogue.content: I think you are someone with a strong sense of responsibility and a wonderful volunteer spirit, enough to willingly take on the role of president for the parents' association.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。そう思っていても、無視されたりありもしない事を言われている現実が辛いんですが、どうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. Even if I think that, the reality of being ignored and having lies spread about me is painful. What should I do?

dialogue.origin: だから、そんなあなたを貶めるような方々には毅然とした態度をとられたらどうかとおもうもでうすが、いかがでしょうか
dialogue.content: That's why, toward the people who are trying to belittle you, I think you should take a firm, resolute stance. What do you think about that?

dialogue.origin: なるほど
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 毅然とした態度ですね
dialogue.content: A firm and resolute stance, right.

dialogue.origin: 自信をもって堂々とした態度をとられたらいいのではとも思います
dialogue.content: I also think it would be good to carry yourself confidently and with dignity.

dialogue.origin: はいあなたがされていることにもっと自信をもたれたらよいかと思いますがいかがでしょうか
dialogue.content: Yes, I think it would be good for you to have more confidence in what you're doing. How does that sound?

dialogue.origin: 家ではねこんでいても、保護者会の仕事や学校では毅然とした態度でいた方がいいという事ですね。なるほどです。
dialogue.content: So, even if I’m bedridden at home, I should maintain a firm attitude during my parents’ association work and at school. That makes sense.

dialogue.origin: そうすれば状況も変わるでしょうか
dialogue.content: If I do that, do you think the situation will change?

dialogue.origin: あなたの体調が心配ですどうかゆっくり休まれて栄養のよいバランスの良いお食事などとられて
dialogue.content: I'm concerned about your health. Please get plenty of rest and eat nutritious, well-balanced meals.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。実は9キロ痩せました
dialogue.content: Thank you. Actually, I've lost 9 kilograms.

dialogue.origin: あなたの体調も心配しています
dialogue.content: I am concerned about your physical condition as well.

dialogue.origin: どうか栄養のバランスがとれたお食事を召し上がってはやく回復されますように
dialogue.content: Please have balanced, nutritious meals, and I hope you recover soon.

dialogue.origin: 心ろ体は繋がっています
dialogue.content: The mind and body are connected.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。そんな人達のせいで、体調を崩すなんて、ばかみたいですね。
dialogue.content: You're right. It feels foolish to let my health suffer because of people like them.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: 早くあなたらしい生活が取り戻せるように祈っています
dialogue.content: I'm hoping you can get back to living your life as your true self again soon.

dialogue.origin: 日頃頑張っている自分へのご褒美に好きな美味しいも
dialogue.content: As a reward to yourself for all your hard work, get something delicious that you like...

dialogue.origin: たべて下さいね
dialogue.content: ...and please enjoy it.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 今日はご相談にきて来て頂いてありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much for coming for a consultation today.

dialogue.origin: 終了ボタン押させていただきますね）
dialogue.content: I’ll go ahead and press the 'end' button now.
